summary: STERIS Irish FinCo Unlimited Company filed a preliminary 424B5 for an offering of two series of senior unsecured notes, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by STERIS plc, STERIS Corporation and STERIS Limited. Principal amounts, coupons and maturities are left blank. Proceeds relate to STERIS Corporation's October 11, 2026 Purchase and Sale Agreement to acquire Xodus Medical, Inc., a Pennsylvania specialty surgical products business, though the offering is not conditioned on closing. A special mandatory redemption applies if the deal does not close by the later of January 11, 2028 or five business days after an extended Outside Date, or if the agreement terminates. Watch acquisition financing timing and redemption triggers.
